title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - PrimaryRawResource
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/PrimaryRawResource. Natural resource or energy that is used as a resource for the first time as input in a process or for creating a solution (source: ISO 59004:2024, clause 3.3.2). Subclass of s4envi:Resource (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.3.3.2.4); location is inherited from the Resource model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PrimaryRawResource'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

resourceKind.description: Property. Open/enumerated vocabulary, flattened from saref:hasFeatureKind whose range is the controlled vocabulary s4envi:PrimaryRawResourceKind -- not modelled as its own entity. The category of this primary raw resource. Known individuals from the ontology (non-exhaustive): 'Diesel', 'Electricity', 'Energy', 'Heat'.
